description: A small, manually verified discovery registry. Feeds and rankings produce review candidates, never automatic timeline entries. Coverage is intentionally incomplete.

sources.name: OpenAI News
sources.note: Official news feed; includes non-release announcements. Publication date is the article date.

sources.name: Google AI
sources.note: Official AI blog feed; publication date is the article date, not a verified product release date.

sources.name: NVIDIA Blog
sources.note: Official general blog feed; includes applications and company news that may not merit inclusion.

sources.name: Claude Code
sources.note: Official repository release feed. Atom updated is modification time, not a verified publication date. Patch releases generally do not merit separate timeline entries.

sources.name: Gemini CLI
sources.note: Official repository release feed; includes preview/nightly versions. Atom updated is modification time, not a verified publication date.

sources.name: Firecracker
sources.note: Official microVM release feed. A release needs a representative technical change to merit inclusion.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis model releases
sources.note: Public model release groups, potentially filtered or paginated. Names are retained exactly; groups can contain several reasoning configurations. Visible month is retained as a period, never an invented day.

sources.name: Arena Text leaderboard
sources.note: Public Text Arena model/configuration names. First observation and leaderboard dates are not model release dates. No score, rank or inclusion decision is inferred.
